title: Web Search & Browsing

body.text: The model's knowledge has a cutoff date, but Search mode lets ChatGPT
search the web in real time with citations
— great for news, latest prices, or recent events.

example: "Search the latest news on this year's tax deduction measures, summarize 5 points, with source links"

title: Use Search wisely

body.text: has citation links and credible sources
— for important matters (finance, health, legal), always click through to the original source to confirm before relying on it.

example: "Compare the current 12-month fixed deposit rates of 5 major banks as a table, citing the banks' websites directly"

question: When should you use Web Search mode?

options.text: When you need the latest info or current events
When you want a faster answer

question: What's a key benefit of answers from Search mode?

options.text: It has source links you can verify
It's shorter than a normal answer

question: You got financial info from Search — what should you do before relying on it?

options.text: Use it right away, the AI already checked
Click through to the original source to confirm accuracy

question: To get the latest event info, what should you do?

options.text: Enable Search/Browsing and have it summarize with sources
Rely purely on the model's memory

question: How do you use Web Search wisely?

options.text: Check the citations the system provides
